**What would you like to be documented or improved**:

**Location** (URL, file path, or section if applicable):

**How this was found** (tick one):
- [ ] **Misled** — I read this and did the wrong thing, or could not work out what to do
- [ ] **Spotted** — I noticed the gap while writing or reviewing something else

<!-- Both are worth filing and neither is ranked. "Misled" is asked for because it names the sentence
     that actually cost somebody time, and that sentence is the one a rewrite has to fix rather than
     merely move. "Spotted" is a fine answer; it just means the reader in the argument is an imagined
     one, so say which reader you had in mind — someone installing for the first time reads a page
     very differently from someone debugging it. -->
